meta.name: cluster-documents
meta.description: Automated content similarity and grouping analysis. Groups related documents by topic, purpose, or content similarity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按主题或内容相似度自动分组文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将大量文档按主题归类
copy.tagline_en: Automatically group documents by topic or content similarity
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to categorize large sets of documents by topic

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以分析一个文档库，根据内容相似度自动将文档分到不同组，并标注每个组的主题。还会找出内容高度雷同的文档（可能重复），并可选生成可视化图表。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 对某个文件夹或文档集合进行相似性分组、或者找出重复文档时，它会触发分析流程。

say.text: 帮我分析这个项目文件夹里的文档，按主题分组。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件夹，生成聚类报告。

say.text: 找出这里哪些文档内容重复或高度相似。
say.note: Claude 会重点输出冗余报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze a document repository, group documents by content similarity, assign topic labels to each cluster, identify highly similar (potentially duplicate) documents, and optionally generate a visualization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to cluster documents in a repository by similarity, find duplicates, or group by topic.

say_en.text: Cluster the documents in this project folder by topic.
say_en.note: Claude reads the folder and generates a clustering report.

say_en.text: Find duplicate or highly similar documents here.
